evidence_chain.m_future_raw_tape_adjoint_context: P2R0F2M ran a complete L15-to-L2 exact-adjoint backward scan over future raw tape features before the forward pass and regressed 0.00836% versus J (3.233766009119748e-8).
evidence_chain.n_learned_rank16_covariance: P2R0F2N improved J by only 0.1044049% and its truth-derived span oracle capped at 2.8928320722187982e-8, capturing 10.535% of endpoint error versus 69.076% needed.
evidence_chain.p_fullrank_nonlinear_roundtrip: P2R0F2P improved J by only 0.0106558% and its truth-optimal emitted-direction oracle capped at 3.216608956319193e-8, capturing 0.5222% of endpoint error.
evidence_chain.teacher_forcing_capacity: With the true previous-layer residual state supplied, the same local innovation form reaches 8.207963477637236e-9, below target.
evidence_chain.conclusion: The observer-on-fixed-tape family is information-capped near 3.23e-8, not capacity-capped. Three materially different operator classes (future-raw adjoint state, learned rank-16 covariance, full-rank nonlinear weight round trip) all land within 0.11% of J, and both truth oracles show learned corrections cannot even point at the residual error. The missing information is what the Q24 host discarded while building its approximation; it is not a function of the recorded 20-feature tape.

proposal.name: host-uncertainty observable tape augmentation
proposal.one_line: Widen the lawful observer tape at the source with the host's own internal approximation-quality observables, then retrain the exact frozen J architecture once on the widened input under the identical nested-OOF law.
candidate_observables_defined_in_host_so: per-layer PSD covariance repair magnitude (pre/post eigenvalue-floor congruence deltas)
per-unit CP3/CP4 carrier cap and compression truncation norms (third/fourth-order structure discarded at the cap)
per-unit Hermite tail energy at the ReLU moment evaluation (order-tail partial sums beyond the kept expansion)
correlation-gauge rescale factors and near-floor variance-trigger margins
per-layer closure self-consistency deltas between emitted and consumed moments
proposal.why_this_is_new_information: Every closed family consumed the same sealed 20-feature tape; none changed what the host records. The host computes exactly where and how much it is approximating; those signals never reach the observer. This changes the information set at the source rather than fitting a fourth operator class on inputs already proven insufficient.
proposal.deployment_cost_note: The native host already computes these quantities internally during its rollout; exposing them to the correction costs only the widened encoder input rows, on the order of tens of millions of FLOPs against a 6.5e10 headroom.
explicitly_not_proposed: any further operator, ensemble, rank, or scalar family on the fixed tape (closed by M/N/P/O)
retuning J on the old tape (closed)

required_before_any_launch: Freeze the exact observable definitions in host source terms, a deterministic append-only v4 feature-store regeneration preregistration with per-row manifests preserving the sealed v3 store, identical target-first mlp_id split law, the exact frozen J retrain law, conservative cost, and strict conjunctive gates; independent prelaunch audit; one arm only.
